_: Region sheet for pirate-freeholds (2.5a1b). Talk is seeded from the region's published place records; every trait cites a lore dossier or says inferred.

entries.name: Alten Corimont and the river camps (the pirate freeholds)

norms.text: Alten Corimont takes anyone and sells to both sides.
Crews are hired by the roll; a name on a roll is a debt owed downriver.
Shares are split by hull and by head, agreed before the boat leaves.
Gang families keep their clutch in camp and their tree a day upriver.

taboos.text: Asking a crew the origin of the last cargo.
Taking sides in a quarrel at the port; neutrality is the town's whole policy.

values.text: Coming back to the tree, even late.

contempts.text: Captains who leave a crew ashore without its share.
Anyone who tried to make Alten Corimont pick a side.

place.text: The river is home; a camp is where the work is this season.

work.text: Roll work, poling and salvage; it pays in tallies more often than coin.

people.text: Mixed crews. A hand is asked what he can lift, never his homeland.

faction.text: The Compact owns the boats; the Salt-Teeth own the rest.

hist.text: The tree upriver knows who is gone; the families answer to it.

empire.text: The navy that came here is a memorial on the waterfront.

trade.text: Smuggling, transit and salvage; the port captain prices every question.

danger.text: The river kills drunks and the camps kill debtors.

rumour.text: More adults go downriver on the roll every year.

directions.text: Ways are given in bends and landings: Nine Bends, the camp, the port.

addressTerms.text: Crew call each other by job or nickname; a stranger is mate until he is trouble.
Mixed-crew loan words for outsiders, Dunmer and Imperial both.

neverSaid.text: How many on the roll never came back.

grievances.text: The camp has no claim on the Hist a day upriver, yet the families stay because the clutch is in the shed.
Nine Bends loses more adults to the downriver roll each year. Its Hist is weakening.

rumours.text: The Salt-Teeth are hiring for something larger than a cargo.
The port captain has been paid twice for the same berth.

views.text: The interior folk look down on river work and buy what it brings.
Riverwalk and Thorn are the next stops down the trunk road; good custom, hard bargains.
Archon's sailors are the only ones who outswim ours.
